0-what-chain.cap: From written to running: the Engine is on, the group is active, the trigger fires, the actions run in order

a.who: Arrow keys as plain hot keys
steps: You want to move the cursor
a.end: Arrows are useless the rest of the time

b.who: In a group you switch on

1-groups-toggle.cap: The same four arrow keys belong to your macros only while the group is on

steps.t: Select or Show a Menu Item

3-actions-log.cap: A macro is a list of actions, done one after another from the top

layers.d: No special prefix. Every macro can read and change it, and it stays on your Mac through restarts
Starts with Instance. This one run, plus the sub-macros it calls
Starts with Local. Only this macro, in this one run

4-variables-scope.cap: Going down, fewer macros can see it and it lives for less time. If you only need it for this run, use Local.

steps.d: Everything on in the Security preferences
Its icon is in the menu bar
Both enabled, group active right now
No other macro uses the same hot key
Step through in the debugger, read Engine.log

6-debug-order.cap: Trouble in the first two breaks every macro at once. The further along, the more it's about this one macro alone.

watch-folder-flow.cap: These four steps run once for every file that arrives. Anything that isn't a PDF stops at step three.

stop-macro-ladder.cap: Ways to stop a macro: try the top one first, move down if it doesn't work, and save the bottom one for when nothing else does.

rungs.d: No Engine, so you can fix the macro
